references.text: Isaiah prophesied about this form of revelation through parables, which Jesus fulfills.
Jesus explains why he uses parables to convey the mysteries of the kingdom, parallel to Mark 4:11.
Luke gives a similar explanation as Mark regarding the use of parables to reveal the mysteries of the kingdom.
The psalm refers to the use of parables and similes to communicate God's work and wisdom, reflecting Jesus' method.
John emphasizes that not everyone will understand or accept the mysteries of God's kingdom.
